title: Pepete
description: Pepete is an artisanal modern bakery and neighborhood cafe in Cairo, celebrated for signature flaky croissants, buttery morning viennoiserie, and handcrafted specialty coffees. Driven by an energetic young founder with an infectious love for warm hospitality, the bakery quickly built a dedicated following of regulars who appreciate authentic European baking methods delivered without any corporate pretension or dull minimalism.

The strategic goal was creating a memorable brand personality that reflected the founder's bold, spirited character rather than blending into generic coffeehouse aesthetics. Pepete was conceived as a vibrant neighborhood sanctuary, a playful corner where serious pastry craft meets an upbeat, genuinely welcoming environment that feels instantly memorable, unapologetically genuine, and deeply fun.
direction: The identity is built to express the brand's freedom. Instead of settling into one visual lane, Pepete borrows the owner's confidence to set its own rules: loud, joyful, a little chaotic in the best way. The goal was to capture that first time through the door feeling, pure and almost childlike, the kind of joy that doesn't ask permission to exist.

The wide, unrestrained color palette is intentional. Pepete isn't directed at a certain type of customer, it's purely neutral, which was extremely challenging when designing the brand's identity, though it was ultimately what made it fun.
As for their slogan and voice? They have all the stuff. What can I say?
